messages:
hana-ml: Quick flag, onboarding evals show q4b-int4-candidate underperforms vs baseline on the 'historical-narrative' prompt slice (~5.2 rougeL). Repro across seeds.

ravi-curation: Which promptset and dedupe settings did we use? could be we stripped summary anchors.

hana-ml: Using promptset hist_narr_v1 (10k examples). We ran semantic dedupe at threshold 0.78 and then canonicalized references last week.

emily-labelops: If dedupe removed paraphrase anchors that informed gold, microgolden relabel could surface that. I can prepare a relabel batch.

kevin-eng: Also want to rule out runtime quant drift for long-memory flows. I'll run an A/B pinned to the same decoding settings.

hana-ml: Eval command: 
```bash
python eval/run_eval.py --model q4b-int4-candidate --dataset datasets/hist_narr_v1.jsonl \
  --slice historical_narrative --metric rougeL --batch 10 --seed 11 --decoding greedy
```

eval-bot: Deploy note: q4b-int4-candidate deployed to staging 2024-06-25T15:40:12Z. Perf 450 tok/s, KV 1.0GB/slot.

ravi-curation: Proposal: create a 350-example microgolden (175 golden + 175 review) sampled by narrative length and presence of multiple timelines. Also keep a restore list of near-duplicates discarded by dedupe.

emily-labelops: Requesting +400 label units for 48h. Instructions will include tags: HALL (hallucination), SEQ (sequence errors), TRUNC (truncation). I'll add a quick span-highlighting step.

kevin-eng: I'll kick off an A/B test baseline (q8b-fp16) vs candidate only on the microgolden, plus a run forcing fp16 math to check numeric divergence.

hana-ml: I'll add a small harness change to log token-level diffs and a span-alignment score; PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/evals/pull/421

eval-bot: AB test scheduled: ab-hist-20240625, shards=4. Expect results in ~90m.

ravi-curation: Creating tracker RDW-8520 and attaching sampling seeds, dedupe whitelist, and label rubric.

emily-labelops: Label batch queued. Will post progress and attach gold artifacts when ready.

hana-ml: Uploaded 50 failing examples + matched controls for quick eyeballing. :eyes:

eval-bot: AB results: baseline (q8b-fp16) > q4b-int4-candidate on historical_narrative by 5.0 rougeL (p=0.004). Token-diff logs: /evals/ab-hist-20240625/logs.tgz

kevin-eng: Looks significant. I'll run kernel bisect and a forced-fp16 run to isolate numeric vs quant math.

ravi-curation: Given the gap, proceed with microgolden relabel and a compact quant calibration sweep (importance-weight long narratives). Run them in parallel.

emily-labelops: Labelers started. ETA artifacts ~40h. Adding burnout guard and a short checklist.

hana-ml: Thanks all. Action items: (1) ravi open RDW ticket + attach seeds, (2) emily reserve label quota, (3) kevin run bisect + fp16 check, (4) hana run post-relabel regression.

ravi-curation: RDW-8520 created and pinned to eng-ml board. Added restore whitelist.

emily-labelops: First label batch done; posting interim quality checks shortly. :white_check_mark:
